samples.xml_description:
Implement a 64-bit ripple carry adder with 16-bit registers to enable 4 pipeline stages. Clock input. Active low reset signal. Enable signal for addition operation. 64-bit input operand A. 64-bit input operand B. 65-bit output representing the sum of adda and addb. Output enable signal. 4 1-bit register for the i_en signal. 64-bit register for the adda operand. 64-bit register for the addb operand. 1-bit register for the carry-in signal. 65-bit register for the result. Output enable signal.

Implement the 64-bit ripple carry adder with 16-bit registers to enable 4 pipeline stages.

Use the following algorithm:

  1. At each clock cycle, if rst_n is asserted, reset all registers to 0.
  2. At each clock cycle, if i_en is asserted, load the i_en signal into the i_en_reg register.
  3. At each clock cycle, if i_en_reg is asserted, load the adda operand into the adda_reg register.
  4. At each clock cycle, if i_en_reg is asserted, load the addb operand into the addb_reg register.
  5. At each clock cycle, if i_en_reg is asserted, calculate the sum of the corresponding 16-bit subsections of adda_reg and addb_reg, and store the result in the result_reg register.
  6. At each clock cycle, if i_en_reg is asserted, shift the carry_in_reg register to the right by 1 bit.
  7. At each clock cycle, if i_en_reg is asserted, set the o_en_reg signal to 1.
  8. At each clock cycle, if i_en_reg is not asserted, set the o_en_reg signal to 0.

Note: The result_reg register should be output on the result port.
